verdicts.reason: A: 'Rated 5 out of 5' has shrunk to unreadable micro-text. The logo sits centred at the top while the quote block is left-aligned at about x=178, so the two use different axes. Putting the logo first also breaks the original reading order, and the right two-thirds of the banner is empty. B: the headline, source line and rating keep a sensible size hierarchy and share a clean left edge. But the logo is centred at the bottom, off that left edge and jammed near the bottom of the canvas. The quote mark floats with a large gap above the headline, and the right half is dead space, so it reads as a left-stacked square layout rather than a real banner.
